content.text: I'll look up how `versionGroupId` is defined and used in the schema and related code.

It’s a nullable column on `chat_message` that groups alternate versions of the same user turn (edit / resend).

When a user edits or regenerates a message, the old one is marked with `supersededAt` and the new one keeps the same `versionGroupId`. That lets the app:

- show version history (`1/3`, `2/3`, …) via `buildVersionInfoMap`
- switch which version is active via `switchMessageVersion`

On first edit, if the original has no group yet, `resolveVersionGroupIdForEdit` sets `versionGroupId` to that message’s own `id`, then reuses it for later versions. User messages also get `versionGroupId = messageId` on insert so the group is ready.
